fields.triggerNotes: Three triggers, in priority order. (1) Performance decay: rolling 90-day AUC more than 0.03 below the registered holdout AUC. (2) Sustained input drift: PSI above 0.2 on a top-6 feature for three consecutive weeks, which distinguishes a real shift from a seasonal blip. (3) A calendar floor of two retrains per year regardless of signal, so the pipeline never sits unexercised long enough to rot. Deliberately no monthly schedule: at Nordkap's claim volume a monthly retrain costs more in review effort than the accuracy it recovers.
fields.pipelineNotes: Azure ML pipeline, fully reproducible. Each run pins a dated data snapshot ID, the git commit of the training code, and the feature-build package version, then logs evaluation on both the fixed holdout set and a recent-claims set so seasonal effects are visible. The run writes a candidate version to the MLflow registry in Staging; nothing promotes automatically. The fairness audit from the Phase 6 Responsible AI review is re-run on every candidate, and a candidate that regresses on any protected-group metric is blocked from promotion.
fields.releaseNotes: Shadow first, then canary. A candidate scores live traffic in shadow mode for two weeks with no effect on analyst queues, which builds a same-traffic comparison against the incumbent. If shadow holds, it moves to a 10% canary for two weeks, then 50%, then full. Win condition agreed with claims operations before any candidate starts: no worse false-positive rate on legitimate claims, and at least a 2-point improvement in fraud caught per 1000 claims. A candidate that merely ties does not ship, because every promotion costs analyst retraining attention.
fields.rollbackNotes: The previous Production version stays registered and warm, so rollback is a registry pointer change plus a scoring-service restart, targeted under 15 minutes. Rollback authority sits with the on-call engineer without needing model-owner approval, since the failure modes that need rollback are time-critical. Tested during the deployment dry run and re-tested each quarter as part of the on-call rotation handover; the last drill is logged in the runbook.
